title: Increase UNEMBEDDING_LR
description: Increased UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.04 to accelerate output layer learning
reflection: Hypothesis failed. Result: val_bpb 1.000984 (baseline 0.996000, −0.00498 regression). The 10× increase destabilized the output layer rather than improving it. The unembedding layer learning rate of 0.004 appears to be well-tuned, not a bottleneck. Unlike MATRIX_LR acceleration in Round 2 which succeeded, the embedding/unembedding parameters are more sensitive to LR changes and may need a different tuning strategy. Optimizer parameters are not all equally responsive to acceleration.
